title: David Goggins's VFW acceptance speech: from 300 pounds and cockroach spraying to Navy SEAL
summary: Goggins accepts the 2018 VFW Americanism Award and tells his origin story: quitting Air Force pararescue, ballooning from 175 to 300 pounds, then losing 160 pounds in under three months to chase SEAL training despite being laughed at by recruiters. He closes by redefining courage as showing up every day for the person beside you.

principles.text: Rock bottom can be the starting line: he went from quitting, to 300 pounds, to deciding to change his life.
principles.quote: I left the Air Force four years later at 300 pounds I went from 175 to 300 pounds
